tags.name: SS Stavronikita
tags.qa_notes: Re-audited 2026-07-13: cross-checked build (Denmark, 1956, ex-Ohio), 1976 fire (6 dead, 3 injured, 24 survivors adrift 4 days), Oct 1977 auction ($30k), Nov 1978 scuttling, and 40m/365ft dimensions against Wikipedia-derived summaries and Divernet/Scubaverse coverage. No conflicts found; all factual claims confirmed.

Re-audited 2026-07-13: dimensions (70ft/21m) and 1919 scuttling date confirmed by uncommoncaribbean.com and carlislebaybarbados.org. Sources CONFLICT on the reason for scuttling: prior text said crew avoided return to post-war Europe; uncommoncaribbean.com and other accounts instead attribute it to fondness for Barbadian rum/island life, or fear of U-boats on the next Atlantic run. Markdown updated to flag this as an unresolved discrepancy rather than assert one story.
Re-audited 2026-07-13: ferro-cement construction, January 1986 sinking, and 12-13m depth confirmed by barbadossnorkelingtours.org. No conflicts found.

Re-audited 2026-07-13: SOURCES CONFLICT on both length and depth. Length reported as 160ft (caribbean-beat.com), 165ft (divehightide.com, loopbarbados.com), and 180ft (numa.net) -- consistently in the 160-180ft/49-55m range but no single figure agreed. Depth reported as 49ft (villasunnysidebarbados-style prior figure), 55ft (caribbean-beat.com), and 60ft (divehightide.com, numa.net, loopbarbados.com); majority of sources cite ~60ft/18m max. Depth field updated from 15m to 18m to match majority sourcing; markdown updated to state the length/depth conflict explicitly rather than assert a single figure.

tags.name: Eillon
tags.qa_notes: Re-audited 2026-07-13: 110ft length, marijuana-smuggling seizure, 6 years impounded at Bridgetown Careenage, 8 June 1996 scuttling, and 17m/55ft max depth all reconfirmed by uncommoncaribbean.com and carlislebaybarbados.org. IMPORTANT SAFETY CORRECTION: sources confirm the bow air pocket contains air that is "highly toxic and entirely unsafe to breathe" -- markdown previously described the air pocket as merely something to "ensure a clear exit before entering" without this warning; corrected to state divers should not surface inside the pocket to breathe.
